# iso-figure

Build an interactive isometric line-art figure of an object in a single self-contained HTML/SVG file: monochrome technical-illustration look on a captioned Fig N plate, parts you can press that produce real output (typed text, a number, a sound, a changed display), and a live state readout — no libraries, no canvas, no 3D engine, just plain SVG from a small projection kernel.
